name: Ferrofluid
use_case: Magnetically-driven Rosensweig instability; spike patterns from standing field waves
composition: Iron oxide nanoparticles (Fe₃O₄, 10 nm) in carrier oil + surfactant

behavior.rosensweig_instability: Above a critical magnetic field strength, the flat surface becomes unstable and forms a hexagonal array of sharp spikes — the Rosensweig (or normal-field) instability.
behavior.cymatic_coupling: Modulating the magnetic field at audio frequencies drives Faraday-like standing waves with spike arrays following nodal geometry.
behavior.pattern_type: hexagonal by default; can be driven to square or stripe phases with anisotropic field geometry

notes: Ferrofluid is a sacred-geometry goldmine: combine acoustic driving with static magnetic bias field and the spikes form 3D standing-wave sculptures.
